baseline_fit.note: actual-mass weighting MIXES UNITS across resources (SPT tokens and Unlimited-Lives minutes outweigh booster counts by 2-4 orders of magnitude); the per-resource rows weight within one unit and are the ones to read. unweighted = plain mean over (cell,resource) pairs with a defined TV.

noise_floor.definition: cv_ma7 = RMS(actual[d] - MA7[d]) / mean(actual), MA7 centred and clipped to days 1..33; tv_ma7 = TV(actual, MA7(actual)) i.e. the same noise in the allocation metric's units; weekend_amp = mean(actual on Fri/Sat/Sun) / mean(actual on Mon-Thu) with isWeekend_ (calendar starts Wednesday: weekend days are 3,4,5,10,11,12,...).

experiments.note: post-processing of the baseline per-category series inside the probe; every category total conserved; TV against the same actuals. E4 takes its schedule from the actuals (see header) - a calendar-input fix, not a model fit.
